title: Harsh words do not finish outside you.
summary: The harm of sharp speech does not stop at the other person. It also deepens the coarseness of the one speaking.
takeaway: Contempt always leaves residue in the speaker.
lifeApplication: Before replying in irritation, ask what kind of interior this sentence is building inside you.

source.shortMeaning: Harsh words return as grief, not mastery.
source.lifeApplication: Do not confuse emotional discharge with strength.

evidence.coreClaim: Harsh words return as grief, not mastery.
evidence.turn: Guard the tongue, and the heart begins to clear.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before replying in irritation, ask what kind of interior this sentence is building inside you.
